newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt buys 150,000 T wheat from Australia/U.S..
newsitem.headline: Egypt buys 150,000 T wheat from Australia/U.S..

text.p: Egypt's official Holding Company for Rice and Flour Mills said on Monday it bought 100,000 tonnes of Australian hard wheat and 50,000 tonnes of either Australian or U.S. hard red wheat.
A company official detailed the deliveries as follows:
- 50,000 tonnes of either Australian hard wheat or U.S. hard red wheat, sellers option, from Tradigrain at $173, delivery April 10 to 20.
- 50,000 tonnes of Australian hard wheat from the Australian Wheat Board (AWB) at $162.5, delivery May 10 to 20.
- 50,000 tonnes of Australian hard wheat from the AWB at $155, delivery June 10 to 20.
